steps.if: the customer has not already been verified in this conversation
steps.quote: Authenticate the customer and confirm identity verification status on file.

steps.do: Confirm that the customer correctly gives 2 of: date of birth, email, phone, address. Share no account information before this.
steps.if: the customer has not already been verified in this conversation
steps.quote: Authenticate the customer and confirm identity verification status on file.

steps.do: Get the current time. It is used for the verification log and for checking account age.

steps.do: Log the verification record.
steps.if: the customer has not already been verified and logged in this conversation
steps.quote: Authenticate the customer and confirm identity verification status on file.

steps.do: Unlock the account lookup tool.
steps.if: the tool is not already unlocked in this conversation
steps.quote: Use get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 to retrieve the bank accounts (checkings, savings) for a customer.

steps.do: Get all of the customer's bank accounts (status, balance, class, date_opened). Read them again even if you read them earlier, because an account may have just been opened.
steps.quote: Checking eligibility requirements for opening new accounts (existing account status, balances, account tenure, number of accounts)

steps.do: Work out each checking account's tenure from the current time and its date_opened. If the account the customer wants to close is the only active checking account open at least 14 days, open the savings account BEFORE closing it. Explain why without exposing internal tool details: savings needs an active checking account held at least 14 days, and the remaining one is too new. If the customer pushes back or asks to close first, give this reason again; do not just insist.
steps.if: the customer wants both to close a checking account and to open savings
steps.quote: Confirm an active checking account exists and meets the 14-day tenure requirement.

steps.do: Check every eligibility item. (1) An active checking account held at least 14 days; one opened in this conversation does not count, but an older active checking account does. (2) Fewer than 5 personal savings accounts. (3) No account in collections and none with a negative balance. If the customer already has 5 personal savings accounts, tell them they have reached the maximum and stop. If any account is in collections or negative, tell them it must be resolved first and stop.
steps.quote: Do not proceed if any item above is not met.

steps.do: Explain that a personal savings account requires an active Rho-Bank checking account. Do not open the savings account, and stop.
steps.if: get_accounts shows no active checking account
steps.quote: Customer has at least one active Rho-Bank checking account.

steps.do: Tell the customer the date they become eligible: 14 days after the earliest active checking account's date_opened. Do not open the account.
steps.if: no active checking account has at least 14 days of tenure
steps.quote: Insufficient checking tenure: If the checking account has been open fewer than 14 days, advise the customer when they will become eligible.

steps.do: If the customer already accepted a savings account earlier in this conversation (for example, from recommend_credit_card_and_savings_account_combination), skip gather_needs and recommend. Go straight to confirm_class with that account's full official name.
steps.if: the customer is eligible and already accepted a savings account recommended earlier in this conversation
steps.quote: Capture the exact account_class string. It must be the full official name ending with “Account” (for example, “Silver Plus Account”, “Gold Account”).

steps.do: Before recommending anything, ask about the customer's savings needs: withdrawals per month, the balance they can keep and their maximum, compounding, ATM rebates, relationship bonus, minimum APY and goals tracking.
steps.if: the customer is eligible and has not already chosen a savings account earlier in this conversation
steps.quote: Discuss available personal savings account options with the customer.

steps.do: Read the customer's credit cards. An EcoCard raises the Green Account (savings) free withdrawals to 15 and adds $20 in ATM rebates. A Gold Rewards Card lowers the Gold Account minimum to $5,000 and adds its relationship bonus.
steps.if: the customer is eligible and has not already chosen a savings account earlier in this conversation
steps.quote: Gold Account holders who also have a Gold Rewards Card receive exclusive benefits that make the account more accessible.

steps.do: Compare every personal savings account against the customer's needs and recommend ONE that meets all of them, applying card-holder benefits only when get_credit_cards shows the card. Exclude any account that fails a need: its opening deposit or ongoing minimum is above the customer's maximum; its free withdrawals are below the customer's monthly count; it lacks ATM rebates the customer needs; or its APY at the customer's balance is below their target. Only Silver Plus Account matches 12–15 withdrawals a month, a relationship bonus, a $2,500–$4,000 balance with nothing near $10,000, daily compounding, ATM fee rebates and savings goals tracking. It is also the only match for frequent withdrawals (3–4 a week), a $5,000–$7,000 balance, daily compounding, ATM rebates and at least 3% APY: its Tier 1 rate is 3.0% below $15,000, and Gold needs $10,000. Eco and premium requests are side wishes that don't fit the hard needs. If the customer asks for one answer, give one. Mention the $1,000 opening deposit, the $2,500 minimum balance and the $8.00 fee charged below it.
steps.if: the customer has not already chosen a savings account earlier in this conversation
steps.quote: Earn an additional relationship APY bonus of 0.025% when you qualify under the relationship criteria.

steps.do: Confirm the chosen account_class with the customer, using the full official name ending with 'Account' (e.g. 'Silver Plus Account').
steps.quote: Capture the exact account_class string. It must be the full official name ending with “Account” (for example, “Silver Plus Account”, “Gold Account”).

steps.do: Unlock the account opening tool.
steps.if: the tool is not already unlocked in this conversation
steps.quote: Use the open_bank_account_4821 tool with account_type set to 'savings' and the confirmed account_class.

steps.do: Open the savings account.

arguments.account_class: the confirmed account class, e.g. 'Silver Plus Account'

steps.if: all eligibility checks passed and the customer confirmed the account_class
steps.quote: Use the open_bank_account_4821 tool with account_type set to 'savings' and the confirmed account_class.

steps.do: Tell the customer the account could not be opened and why. Do not retry with different values unless the customer confirms them. If a system error blocks the opening, offer a human agent and transfer only if the customer agrees, using reason technical_system_error.

args.summary: the opening attempt and the error returned

steps.if: open_bank_account_4821 returned a system error that cannot be resolved and the customer agrees to a transfer
steps.quote: System error or outage preventing completion of the customer's request

steps.do: Ask whether the customer wants the opening deposit transferred from checking now.
steps.quote: Ask the customer if they want you to transfer the opening deposit from their checking account now.

steps.do: Before transferring, confirm that the source checking account and the new savings account are both ACTIVE/OPEN and that the source balance covers the amount. If not, offer a different amount or source account.
steps.if: the customer says yes
steps.quote: - Verify the source account has sufficient available funds to cover the transfer amount

steps.do: Unlock and call transfer_funds_between_bank_accounts_7291 to move the required opening deposit from an OPEN checking account with enough funds to the new savings account. On an insufficient-funds error, offer to adjust the amount or use another source account.
steps.if: the customer says yes
steps.quote: If yes: use transfer_funds_between_bank_accounts_7291 to transfer the required amount from the customer’s checking account to the newly opened savings account.

steps.do: Tell the customer the transfer did not go through. On insufficient funds, re-check the funds and offer to adjust the amount or use another source account. If they do not fund now, give the 30-day funding deadline.
steps.if: transfer_funds_between_bank_accounts_7291 returned an error
steps.quote: Offer to adjust the amount or select a different source account after re-validating available funds

steps.do: Tell the customer they have 30 days to fund the account by internal transfer or external deposit (such as depositing a check themselves), or it will be closed.
steps.if: the customer declines the transfer
steps.quote: If no: inform the customer they have 30 days to fund the account (via internal transfer or external deposit) or the account will be closed.

steps.do: Give the new account details and either the funding status or the funding deadline. If the customer also asked to close a checking account, continue with closing_personal_checking_accounts now.
steps.quote: Provide the new account details and confirm the funding status or the funding deadline.

If the customer also asked to close a checking account, closing_personal_checking_accounts follows.

steps.do: Confirm the account status is OPEN. If it is not, tell the customer the account cannot be closed in its current status and stop.
steps.quote: Account status is OPEN

steps.if: check_pending shows any transaction with status 'pending'
steps.quote: Additionally, there cannot be any pending transactions on the account, as these need to clear first.

steps.do: Tell the customer the fee amount, and that it is taken from the account balance with no other way to pay. The balance must be at least the fee (or $0 if no fee applies). Ask how they want to add the funds: deposit a check themselves, or have you transfer from another of their OPEN accounts.
steps.if: an early closure fee applies and the balance is below the fee
steps.quote: If an early closure fee applies, the account balance must be at least the fee amount; otherwise, account balance (current_holdings) must be $0. The fee is deducted directly from the account balance and there is no alternative payment method.

steps.if: the customer wants to cover the fee by depositing a check
steps.quote: To help a customer deposit a check, give them the deposit_check_3847 tool.

steps.quote: Have the user call deposit_check_3847(account_id, check_amount) where account_id is the ID of the account they want to deposit into and check_amount is the amount of the check in USD.

steps.do: Unlock transfer_funds_between_bank_accounts_7291 if needed. Transfer the amount still missing to reach the fee (fee minus current balance) from the OPEN account the customer chose into the account to close. Before calling, confirm the source is OPEN/ACTIVE and its balance covers the amount. On insufficient funds, offer another amount or source.

arguments.source_account_id: the customer-chosen OPEN account from get_accounts_close
arguments.amount: the early closure fee minus the current balance

steps.if: the customer chooses to cover the fee by an internal transfer and authorizes it
steps.quote: Moving funds between a customer’s checking and savings accounts at their request

steps.do: Look up the accounts again to confirm the balance now covers the fee. If it does not, explain what is still missing and do not close.
steps.if: the customer deposited or transferred funds to cover the fee
steps.quote: Verifying pre-closure requirements when closing accounts

steps.do: Unlock transfer_funds_between_bank_accounts_7291 and move the excess balance to another OPEN account of the customer's that they choose. Move the balance minus any applicable fee, or the full balance if no fee applies. If the customer declines, explain that the closure cannot go ahead until the balance requirement is met.

arguments.destination_account_id: another OPEN account of the customer, chosen by the customer
arguments.amount: the balance minus any applicable early closure fee

steps.if: the balance is above $0 with no fee (or above the fee when one applies), and the customer authorizes moving it
steps.quote: Consolidating balances prior to closing one of the customer’s accounts

steps.do: Tell the customer any early closure fee that applies and the tier's notice period (mid tier: 3 days), and get their confirmation to proceed.
steps.if: status is OPEN and there are no pending transactions
steps.quote: Determine the account tier and applicable fees/notice period.

steps.do: Unlock get_debit_cards_by_account_id_7823 and list the debit cards on the account to close.
steps.if: the customer confirmed the closure
steps.quote: Use get_debit_cards_by_account_id_7823 to look up all debit cards associated with a specific checking account.

steps.do: For each ACTIVE or PENDING card, check three things. (1) No pending transactions on the card (check_pending). (2) No pending refunds. (3) The card has been active at least 14 days (date_issued compared with c_get_time). The account_closing reason does not bypass the age rule. If a card fails, tell the customer what must be resolved, give the earliest date when age is the problem, and do not close the card or the account.
steps.if: get_debit_cards returns a card in ACTIVE or PENDING status
steps.quote: Check eligibility requirements. If any requirement is not met, inform the customer what needs to be resolved and do not proceed with closure.

steps.do: For each ACTIVE or PENDING card, tell the customer it must be closed before the account. Then unlock close_debit_card_4721 and close it with reason 'account_closing'. If a card cannot be closed (pending transactions or refunds), explain what must be resolved and do not close the account.
steps.if: get_debit_cards returns a card in ACTIVE or PENDING status, the card passed check_cards, and the customer confirmed the closure
steps.quote: If the linked checking account is being closed, all associated debit cards must be closed first

steps.do: Unlock the account closing tool.
steps.if: the tool is not already unlocked in this conversation
steps.quote: Use close_bank_account_7392 to close the account.

steps.do: Close the checking account.
steps.if: all pre-closure requirements are met: status OPEN, no pending transactions, balance requirement met, linked debit cards closed, and the customer confirmed after hearing the fee and notice terms
steps.quote: Use close_bank_account_7392 to close the account.

steps.do: Confirm the closure and the fee deducted.
steps.quote: Verify pre-closure requirements are met.

steps.quote: This can occur when attempting to close an account. Instruct the customer to wait 48 hours and try again.

steps.do: If the closure fails with another error you cannot resolve, tell the customer and ask whether they want a human agent. Transfer only if they agree, using reason account_closure_request.

steps.if: close_bank_account_7392 returned an error other than 903 and the customer agrees to a transfer

Procedure for closing personal checking: pre-closure requirements, tier fees and notice periods, close_bank_account_7392.
get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847, for eligibility and pre-closure checks.

Transfer reason codes; closure starts only on the customer's explicit request.

open_questions: The closure notice period (for example, 3 days for mid tier) is listed, but no step says whether it delays the close_bank_account_7392 call.
close_bank_account_7392's exact signature is not documented; account_id is assumed.
Dark Green, Purple and Gold Years checking accounts have no closure tier listed.
When a fee applies and the balance is above it, the documents do not say whether the excess must be moved out first.
The criteria for the Silver Plus 'relationship criteria' are not defined beyond holding multiple Rho-Bank products.
No documented tool field shows pending refunds on a debit card; how check_cards reads them is unclear.

when.quote: Procedure for opening personal savings accounts.

starts.note: Use this job only when the customer asks to open a savings account. When the same customer also wants to close a checking account, do this job first if the closure would leave no checking account that has been open at least 14 days.
starts.quote: Must have held their checking account for at least 14 days

tools.not_used: Never used in this job. The closing_personal_checking_accounts job uses it. This job only reads the closure rules to decide which job to do first.
Not used on the normal path, because the agent can open the account itself. Use it only under the policy: when a call returns an error that cannot be fixed, or when the customer has asked 4 times.

info.about: At least 2 of these: date of birth, email, phone number, address. Also the name, email or user id used to find the record.
info.ask: To verify your identity, could you give me your full name and two of these: your date of birth, email, phone number or address?

info.about: Whether the customer also wants to close a checking account in this conversation, and which one
info.ask: Is there anything else you'd like to do with your accounts today, such as closing one?

info.about: About how many withdrawals or transfers the customer expects to make from savings each month
info.ask: About how many withdrawals or transfers do you expect to make from this savings account each month?

info.about: The balance the customer can realistically keep in the account, and any amount they cannot commit to
info.ask: What balance can you comfortably keep in the account on an ongoing basis?

info.about: Whether the customer needs daily compounding
info.ask: Do you have a preference for how often interest compounds?

info.about: Whether the customer wants out-of-network ATM fees rebated
info.ask: Do you use out-of-network ATMs and want those fees rebated?

info.about: Whether the customer wants an extra interest bonus for holding other Rho-Bank products
info.ask: Is earning a bonus rate for keeping your other banking with Rho-Bank important to you?

info.about: Whether the customer wants built-in savings goals tracking
info.ask: Would built-in tools for setting and tracking savings goals be useful to you?

info.about: Any other wishes, such as eco-friendly or premium features
info.ask: Is there anything else you'd like the account to have?

info.about: The full official savings account name the customer confirms, ending with 'Account'
info.ask: Would you like me to open the <recommended account name> for you?

info.about: Whether the customer wants the agent to transfer the opening deposit from checking now, and the amount
info.ask: Would you like me to transfer the opening deposit from your checking account now? If so, how much?

steps.do: Greet the customer, then ask for the details needed to find and verify them (see identity_values).
steps.quote: Authenticate the customer and confirm identity verification status on file.

steps.do: Find the customer's record with get_user_information_by_name (case sensitive), get_user_information_by_email or get_user_information_by_id, using the identifier the customer gave.

args.customer_name: the name the customer gave, or use the email or user id variant with what the customer gave

steps.quote: 1) Verify identity

steps.do: Check that at least 2 of the customer's values (date of birth, email, phone, address) match the record. If they do not, share nothing about the account. Ask the customer to try again, and stop if they cannot verify.
steps.quote: Authenticate the customer and confirm identity verification status on file.

steps.do: Get the current time. It is used for the verification log and for working out account tenure.
steps.quote: The customer’s checking account tenure is at least 14 days.

steps.do: Log the verification once per conversation.
steps.if: the customer was verified in step verify
steps.quote: Authenticate the customer and confirm identity verification status on file.

steps.do: Unlock get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 with unlock_discoverable_agent_tool, then run it with call_discoverable_agent_tool. It returns every account's type, class, status, balance and date_opened.
steps.quote: Checking eligibility requirements for opening new accounts (existing account status, balances, account tenure, number of accounts)

steps.do: If the customer also wants to close a checking account, check whether, after that closure, an OPEN checking account would remain that has been open at least 14 days (date_opened compared with get_time). If none would remain, do this savings job first. Explain the reason to the customer: savings eligibility needs a checking account held at least 14 days, and the remaining account is too new. Once the customer agrees, go on. If a qualifying account would remain, the order is the customer's choice.
steps.if: the customer also asked to close a checking account
steps.quote: Must have held their checking account for at least 14 days

steps.do: Check every requirement. (1) At least one OPEN checking account. (2) That checking account's date_opened is at least 14 days before get_time. (3) Fewer than 5 personal savings accounts. (4) No account has a negative balance or is in collections.
steps.quote: Do not proceed if any item above is not met.

steps.do: Tell the customer they are not yet eligible. Give the date they become eligible: the qualifying checking account's date_opened plus 14 days. Do not open the account.
steps.if: no OPEN checking account has been open at least 14 days
steps.quote: Insufficient checking tenure: If the checking account has been open fewer than 14 days, advise the customer when they will become eligible.

steps.do: Tell the customer they have reached the maximum number of personal savings accounts. Do not open a new one.
steps.if: the customer already has 5 personal savings accounts
steps.quote: Exceeds savings account limit: If the customer already has 5 personal savings accounts, do not open a new one. Inform the customer they have reached the maximum.

steps.do: Tell the customer the negative balance or collections issue must be resolved before a savings account can be opened. Stop.
steps.if: any account has a negative balance or is in collections
steps.quote: Collections or negative balances: Resolve these issues first; do not proceed until all accounts are in good standing.

steps.do: Ask about the customer's savings needs: monthly withdrawals, the balance they can keep, compounding, ATM fee rebates, a relationship bonus, savings goals tracking and any other preferences. Keep asking until each need is known.
steps.if: the customer is eligible
steps.quote: Discuss available personal savings account options with the customer.

steps.do: Read the customer's credit cards. An EcoCard changes the Green Account (savings) withdrawal limit and ATM rebates. A Gold Rewards Card changes the Gold Account minimum balance and relationship bonus.
steps.if: the customer is eligible
steps.quote: Gold Account holders who also have a Gold Rewards Card receive exclusive benefits that make the account more accessible.

steps.do: Compare every personal savings account against each stated need, using the rules table: free withdrawals, ongoing minimum balance against what the customer can keep, compounding, ATM rebates, relationship bonus and savings goals. Recommend the ONE account that meets all of them. When the customer asks for a single answer, do not offer a list. Answer side questions (eco-friendly, premium) honestly, but do not let them override a hard need such as the withdrawal count or the minimum balance.
steps.if: the customer is eligible
steps.quote: Discuss available personal savings account options with the customer.

steps.do: Ask the customer to confirm the account to open. Record its full official name ending with 'Account', for example 'Silver Plus Account'.
steps.quote: account_class: the full official account name ending with 'Account' exactly as confirmed with the customer.

steps.do: Open the savings account. Unlock open_bank_account_4821 first if it is not already unlocked. Keep the new account_id.
steps.if: every eligibility requirement is met and the customer confirmed the account_class
steps.quote: Use the open_bank_account_4821 tool with account_type set to 'savings' and the confirmed account_class.

steps.do: Ask whether the customer wants you to transfer the opening deposit from their checking account now. If yes, confirm the amount, which must be at least the account's minimum opening deposit.
steps.if: open_account succeeded
steps.quote: Ask the customer if they want you to transfer the opening deposit from their checking account now.

steps.do: Unlock transfer_funds_between_bank_accounts_7291 and run it, taking the money from an OPEN checking account whose balance covers the amount. If it returns insufficient funds, offer a different amount or source account. Otherwise give the 30-day funding notice.

args.source_account_id: an OPEN checking account from get_accounts that the customer chooses

steps.if: the customer authorizes the opening-deposit transfer now
steps.quote: If yes, use transfer_funds_between_bank_accounts_7291 to transfer the required amount.

steps.do: Tell the customer they have 30 days to fund the account by internal transfer or external deposit, or the account will be closed.
steps.if: the customer declines the transfer now, or the transfer fails
steps.quote: If no: inform the customer they have 30 days to fund the account (via internal transfer or external deposit) or the account will be closed.

steps.do: Give the new account's details and confirm either the funding status or the funding deadline. Then go on to any remaining job, such as the checking closure.
steps.quote: Provide the new account details and confirm the funding status or the funding deadline.

rules.rule: Eligibility needs all of these: the customer is verified; holds at least one active checking account; that checking account has been held at least 14 days; has fewer than 5 personal savings accounts; has no accounts in collections and no negative balances.
rules.quote: Customer currently holds fewer than 5 personal savings accounts.

rules.rule: Checking tenure is at least 14 days, worked out from date_opened and get_current_time.
rules.quote: Must have held their checking account for at least 14 days

rules.rule: Silver Plus Account: $1,000 opening deposit, $2,500 ongoing minimum ($8.00 monthly fee below it), daily compounding, 15 free withdrawals per month ($1.00 for each extra), ATM fee rebates up to 25 per month, 0.025% relationship APY bonus, built-in savings goals tracking. APY is 3.0% in Tier 1 and 4.5% in Tier 2, which starts at $15,000.
rules.quote: Earn an additional relationship APY bonus of 0.025% when you qualify under the relationship criteria.

rules.rule: Silver Plus Account has 15 free withdrawals a month and a $2,500 ongoing minimum.
rules.quote: You have up to 15 free withdrawals each month.

rules.rule: Silver Plus Account has built-in savings goals tracking.
rules.quote: Use the integrated goals tool to set targets, monitor progress, and visualize how contributions accelerate over time. The feature is enabled: Yes.

rules.rule: Silver Plus Account rebates ATM fees up to 25 a month.
rules.quote: Receive ATM fee rebates up to 25 each month.

rules.rule: Silver Account: $500 opening deposit, $1,000 minimum, daily compounding, only 10 free withdrawals per cycle, ATM rebates up to 15, 0.025% relationship bonus. Savings goals tracking is not listed.
rules.quote: Track your withdrawal activity; transactions beyond 10 in a cycle may incur an excess withdrawal fee as described in your account disclosures.

rules.rule: Silver Account has a relationship bonus and ATM rebates up to 15 a month.
rules.quote: Yes. You can receive ATM fee rebates up to 15 each month.

rules.rule: Gold Account: $5,000 opening deposit, $10,000 ongoing minimum ($5,000 for Gold Rewards Card holders), 20 withdrawals a month, ATM rebates up to $30, daily compounding. Its relationship bonus is only for Gold Rewards Card holders.
rules.quote: Ongoing minimum balance: $10,000

rules.rule: Gold Account relationship bonus applies to Gold Rewards Card holders.
rules.quote: As a Gold Rewards Card holder, you receive an additional 0.025% relationship bonus APY on top of the base rate.

rules.rule: Green Account (savings) is the eco option: $100 opening deposit, $500 minimum, 8 free withdrawals a month, paperless statements required, daily compounding. With an EcoCard it gets 15 withdrawals and $20 in ATM rebates. Savings goals and a relationship bonus are not listed.
rules.quote: Plan withdrawals to stay within 8 each month.

rules.rule: EcoCard holders get 15 withdrawals and ATM rebates on the Green Account (savings).
rules.quote: Increased monthly free withdrawals: 8 + 7 = 15 total free withdrawals per month

rules.rule: Bronze Account: $0 minimum, but only 6 free withdrawals a month. No ATM rebates or savings goals are listed.
rules.quote: Free withdrawals per month: 6

rules.rule: Premium accounts need high balances: Gold Plus needs a $25,000 minimum, Platinum $50,000, Platinum Plus $100,000, Diamond Elite $250,000.
rules.quote: Keep your ongoing balance at or above $50,000.

rules.rule: Linked-checking APY boosts apply only to the listed pairings, and only the highest boost applies.
rules.quote: Only the HIGHEST checking account APY boost is applied to the savings account.

draft.done_when: The savings account is open and the customer has heard the account details plus either a completed funding transfer or the 30-day funding deadline. Or the customer has been told why they are not eligible and, for tenure, when they will be.

when.quote: Verifying pre-closure requirements when closing accounts

starts.note: Use this job only when the customer explicitly asks to close a checking account. Verification from the first job carries over.
starts.quote: Customer is explicitly requesting to close their account

info.about: Which checking account the customer wants closed
info.ask: Which checking account would you like to close?

info.about: How the customer will bring the balance up to the early closure fee: depositing a check themselves, or an internal transfer from another of their accounts
info.ask: The early closure fee is taken from the account's balance. Would you like to deposit a check into it, or have me transfer funds from another of your accounts?

info.about: The amount of the check the customer will deposit
info.ask: What is the amount of the check you'd like to deposit?

info.about: Which of the customer's accounts to transfer from, and how much
info.ask: Which account should I transfer from, and do you authorize a transfer of the needed amount?

steps.do: Confirm which checking account the customer wants closed. If the customer is not yet verified, run the verification steps of the first job.
steps.quote: Verify pre-closure requirements are met.

steps.do: Read the customer's accounts again, unlocking the tool if needed, to get the target account's class, status, balance and date_opened.
steps.quote: Verifying pre-closure requirements when closing accounts

steps.do: Get the current time to work out the account's age.
steps.quote: Determine the account tier and applicable fees/notice period.

steps.do: Unlock and read the target account's transactions, and look for any with status 'pending'.
steps.quote: Transaction status, either 'posted' or 'pending'

steps.do: Unlock and read the debit cards linked to the target checking account.
steps.quote: Use get_debit_cards_by_account_id_7823 to look up all debit cards associated with a specific checking account.

steps.do: Check that the account status is OPEN and it has no pending transactions. If either fails, tell the customer what must be resolved (wait for pending transactions to settle) and do not close.
steps.quote: No pending transactions for this account

steps.do: Find the account's tier from its account_class. Work out its age as get_time_close minus date_opened. The early closure fee applies when the age is inside the tier's window. Tell the customer the fee amount and the notice period.
steps.quote: Determine the account tier and applicable fees/notice period.

steps.do: If a fee applies, the balance must be at least the fee. If no fee applies, the balance must be $0. Explain that the fee is taken from the balance and there is no other way to pay it.
steps.quote: If an early closure fee applies, the account balance must be at least the fee amount; otherwise, account balance (current_holdings) must be $0.

steps.do: Ask how the customer wants to bring the balance up to the fee: deposit a check themselves, or have the agent transfer from another of their OPEN accounts.
steps.if: a fee applies and the balance is below the fee
steps.quote: The fee is deducted directly from the account balance and there is no alternative payment method.

steps.do: Give the customer deposit_check_3847. Explain that they call it with account_id = the account being closed and check_amount = the check's amount in USD. The agent cannot deposit the check for them.
steps.if: the customer wants to deposit a check to cover the fee
steps.quote: To help a customer deposit a check, give them the deposit_check_3847 tool.

steps.do: The customer deposits the check into the account being closed.

args.check_amount: the check amount the customer states

steps.quote: Have the user call deposit_check_3847(account_id, check_amount) where account_id is the ID of the account they want to deposit into and check_amount is the amount of the check in USD.

steps.do: Transfer the amount the customer authorized. To cover a fee, move it into the account being closed. When no fee applies and the balance is above $0, move the remaining balance out to another account the customer chooses. On insufficient funds, offer a different amount or source.

args.source_account_id: the customer-chosen OPEN account (or the account being closed when emptying it)
args.destination_account_id: the account being closed (or the customer-chosen account when emptying it)

steps.if: the customer authorizes a transfer, either to cover the fee or to empty a balance when no fee applies
steps.quote: Consolidating balances before account closure

steps.do: Read the accounts again and confirm the balance now meets the requirement: at least the fee, or $0 when no fee applies. If it still does not, explain what remains and do not close.
steps.if: funds were deposited or transferred
steps.quote: Verify pre-closure requirements are met.

steps.do: Each ACTIVE or PENDING debit card on the account must be closed first. Check that the card has no pending transactions or refunds and has been active at least 14 days (date_issued compared with get_time_close). If a card fails, tell the customer what must be resolved and do not close the account.
steps.if: get_cards returned any ACTIVE or PENDING card
steps.quote: Check eligibility requirements. If any requirement is not met, inform the customer what needs to be resolved and do not proceed with closure.

steps.do: Unlock close_debit_card_4721, then close each ACTIVE or PENDING card linked to the account.
steps.if: the account balance and status requirements are met and every card passed check_cards
steps.quote: If the linked checking account is being closed, all associated debit cards must be closed first

steps.do: Unlock close_bank_account_7392 and close the account.
steps.if: status is OPEN, there are no pending transactions, the balance meets the fee or $0 rule, all linked debit cards are closed, and the customer confirms the closure
steps.quote: Use close_bank_account_7392 to close the account.

steps.do: If the closure returns Error 903, tell the customer to wait 48 hours and try again. For any other error you cannot resolve, ask whether the customer wants a human agent. If yes, transfer with reason technical_system_error.

args.summary: what was attempted and the error

steps.if: close_account returned an error that is not 903 and the customer agrees to a transfer
steps.quote: This can occur when attempting to close an account. Instruct the customer to wait 48 hours and try again.

steps.do: Confirm the account is closed and state any fee deducted.
steps.if: close_account succeeded
steps.quote: Use close_bank_account_7392 to close the account.

rules.rule: Before closure: status is OPEN, there are no pending transactions, and the balance is at least the fee when a fee applies, or $0 otherwise.
rules.quote: If an early closure fee applies, the account balance must be at least the fee amount; otherwise, account balance (current_holdings) must be $0.

rules.rule: Entry tier (Light Blue Account, Light Green Account, Green Fee-Free Account): $15 if closed within 30 days; notice period 0 days.
rules.quote: Early closure fee: $15 if closed within 30 days

rules.rule: Mid tier (Blue Account, Green Account (checking)): $25 if closed within 60 days; notice period 3 days.
rules.quote: MID TIER (Blue Account, Green Account (checking))

rules.rule: Premium tier (Evergreen Account): $50 if closed within 90 days; notice period 7 days.
rules.quote: Early closure fee: $50 if closed within 90 days

rules.rule: Elite tier (Bluest Account): $100 if closed within 180 days; notice period 14 days.
rules.quote: Early closure fee: $100 if closed within 180 days

rules.rule: The fee can only be paid from the account balance.
rules.quote: The fee is deducted directly from the account balance and there is no alternative payment method.

rules.rule: The agent cannot deposit checks. Only the customer can, through deposit_check_3847.
rules.quote: Note: The agent cannot deposit checks on behalf of the customer

rules.rule: A transfer needs the customer's authorization, and both accounts must be ACTIVE or OPEN.
rules.quote: Ensure the two accounts belong to the same customer and the customer has authorized the transfer

rules.rule: Linked debit cards must be closed before the checking account. A card's minimum age is 14 days for the account_closing reason.
rules.quote: Minimum card age: The debit card must have been active for at least 14 days.

draft.done_when: The checking account is closed and confirmed to the customer. Or the customer has been told exactly which requirement (status, pending transactions, balance or fee funding, debit card) blocks closure, or that they should retry after 48 hours on Error 903.
